d:
Barack Obama has mocked Donald Trump over the White House renovation controversy, claiming the administration mobilised a government response to his Cheesecake Factory joke while failing to address his allegations of corruption and rising costs.
Speaking at a Georgia campaign rally, Obama backed Democratic Senator Jon Ossoff and gubernatorial candidate Keisha Lance Bottoms ahead of the November 3, 2026 US midterm elections. Ossoff faces Republican Mike Collins, while Bottoms takes on Rick Jackson in the Georgia governor's race.
